propositions: JiraDataCenterTransport lacks 12 methods the core reconciler calls, causing AttributeError on writing passes or silent data loss when exceptions are swallowed at call sites
TicketTransport Protocol is missing @runtime_checkable decorator and declares insufficient members, making isinstance conformance checks raise TypeError instead of validating at construction
inbound_fields._identity_of reads only accountId, causing reporter mutations to re-emit on every DC pass because DC reporter yields account_id=None, breaking idempotence

set_entity_property and other swallowed members fail silently in 7 of 12 cases, producing convergence reports while data silently does not sync, making absence of errors insufficient evidence of correctness
DC transport raises jira.exceptions.JIRAError which core modules catch as urllib.error.HTTPError, causing exception translation failures and silent loss of deletion detection (J10 prerequisite)
get_parent_map Cloud implementation uses /rest/api/3/search/jql with cursor pagination rejected on DC as HTTP 400, requiring fresh v2 offset-paging implementation
